text: Step body length: hard ceilings per step are 833 characters (1 paragraph), 784 (2) and 735 (3), counting spaces and punctuation. The target is about half the ceiling (roughly 370-420 characters per step); the divider aims for the target and goes longer only when a sentence or block cannot be split without breaking a rule. A step must also fit the portrait step body in the primary layout; whichever limit is tighter applies.
